verdict.rationale: Docs clearly show schema-validated structured output via `output_type` as a Pydantic model that forces the model to match a spec (pydantic-ai-docs-6/18/28/44), and the agent architecture treats structured output as a first-class concept. However, hands-on community evidence directly contradicts reliability of this exact mechanism: one developer reports that vanilla Pydantic AI 'rarely' succeeds at producing valid objects 'regardless of retries,' whereas a hand-rolled OpenAI call with manual JSON parsing worked (pydantic-ai-comm-7), and another reports structured output being 'broken' for Azure OpenAI (pydantic-ai-comm-5). missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the automatic retry-on-validation-failure mechanism itself, and independent corroboration that retries work reliably in practice.
